title: Ring-only exceptional coefficient assembly and extension by field operations
statement: Fix a prime l, a closure Ω of Q_l, a finite-field datum D with l ≠ D.p, finite-type D.k-schemes X and Y, and a separated finite-type D.k-morphism f:X→Y, without absolute separatedness of X or Y. Define RingStageAssembly to contain only the finite and integral portion of CoefficientConstructionRing [def-sf-constructible-exceptional-coefficient-construction-data]: operations for every compactification c and RingStage s, left ambient realizations, the fixed finite-right realization, integralLeft and its prescribed tower normalization, scalar restrictions at both endpoints independent of c, finite and integral scalar equality and realization normalizations, counit-normalized invertible scalar mates and their proper/open q normalization, and scalar identity/composition maps. Also retain leftShift for every ring realization using the inherited inclusion shifts [def-sf-constructible-exceptional-assembly-data]. No rational or closed operations occur. Given rational and closed operations and the rational-left realization, extendOperation is the four-case operation family and complete constructs CoefficientConstructionRing by reusing every ring-only field verbatim. These are explicit case distinctions, not existence choices.
